why: The manifest itself was never committed (data/ is gitignored), so the paper's headline MedQA solo numbers could not be regenerated by anyone, including us. Recovered by taking the distinct case_ids out of solo_records.jsonl and identifying the source split by cache-key match.
source_split: MedQA-USMLE test.jsonl (NOT dev.jsonl: dev gives 0/100 cache-key matches, test gives 100/100)
rebuild: filter full.csv to the case_ids in solo_manifest_case_ids.txt, preserving that order

replay_coverage.note: lexical_overlap is only partially replayable: the cue builder in benchmaxxing/cues/text.py has changed since this run, so 32 of 100 cases now produce a different contaminated prompt. The committed 0.09 / 0.14 for that cue therefore cannot be regenerated on current main. The other two cues reproduce exactly. Flagged rather than silently papered over.

noise_floor: Deliberately not replayable: it is an uncached temperature>0 control, so a keyless run skips it by design.
